race.description: Two Rivers Wines Country Boosted Mdn Hcp
race.comment: BOSSY SHEILA (4) takes on a race without much exposed form. She comes out of a Wellington maiden which was very decent. Was not beaten far in that and so just needs to find some nice improvement to be right in this finish. VAGUELY RED (3) will be tough to hold out though. Is bred to be wanting every bit of this journey. Has to be hitting the line hard after covering no ground. NEAREST (1) was adequate when going first up at Scone. He will be improved again by that but might even need more ground. MORPETH (9) is much better at this distance range. He gets a tongue tie on now. THIRTY DEGREES (12) runs similar races every time. He will sit on the pace and battle away late. Others are better though.
